Mine is probably getting mugged in Sao Paulo, Brazil. Two guys came from behind by surprise and one pointed a gun at me (under his t-shirt of course, but I did not want to take the risk). I had my phone, wallet and ID on me but luckily they only took the phone and ran away. Still, I felt very lost because it was a Sunday and there is little to no police there in the part of the city that they call Cracolandia.

After the mugging, I still had to leave that part of the city and there was many crack addicts watching the scene and shouting / laughing at me. It was pretty scary because in Brazil, literally everything is possible from what I've heard from locals.

I was more then relieved when I made it back to the people I couchsurfed with!

What is your craziest travel story?

A (now pretty famous) German DJ told me a similar story. He was doing a gig with his girlfriend and a bunch of guys jumped them in a park and took their wallets, phones & wedding ring. The robbers didn't have pistols though, they used knives. I guess I won't be visiting Brazil any time soon :)

As for my crazy travel story - I think I have many, but this one was the first one to come to my mind right now: we were chased by a "helpful dude wanting to show us to our hotel" when I was in China. Our cab driver got our hotel address wrong and dropped us off some 200 meters away from the hotel we were staying at. A guy on the street noticed us and started to approach us. We knew where we were going, so we didn't bother stopping. We went straight to the hotel and this guy was following us. Once we went inside and approached reception staff, this guy came in after us and realized he was too late. The receptionist asked him if he needed help. This is where he decided to leave us alone and get out of the hotel. Oh, and nobody in the hotel could speak English :)
